name: subspace_v2_auto_32b_gen
command: mkdir -p logs/subspace_v2 && PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True python -m scripts.evaluation.gen_teacher_targets_v2 --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --split train --stub auto --stubs_per_example 4 --pivots indent var eq |& tee logs/subspace_v2/gen_train_32b_auto.log

name: subspace_v2_auto_32b_train
command: mkdir -p logs/subspace_v2 && PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True python -m scripts.evaluation.train_subspace_probe_v2 --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --targets data/subspace_v2/teacher_targets/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct/stub=auto/train.json --read_lo 35 --read_hi 45 --r 64 |& tee logs/subspace_v2/train_32b_auto.log

name: subspace_v2_auto_32b_eval
command: mkdir -p logs/subspace_v2 && PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_subspace_probe_v2 --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --probe results/subspace_probe_v2/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct/r64__L35-45__a0.1__stub=auto/probe.pt --split_file data/subspace_v2/teacher_targets/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct/stub=auto/predicate_split__seed7__ho0.3.json |& tee logs/subspace_v2/eval_32b_auto.log
